sources.title: WhaleID — Building the Future of Whale Identification
sources.snippet: WhaleID is the first AI system built for underwater whale identification. It uses 7 neural networks to analyze full-body underwater humpback whale photos from dive and snorkel encounters — head tubercle patterns, pectoral fin scarring, body markings, dorsal fin shape, and fluke trailing edges.

sources.snippet: DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) is a more efficient attention mechanism, first used in DeepSeek V3.2-Exp, released 29 September 2025, based on previous research published in February. [64][65] Competing Chinese lab Z.ai adopted DSA in its GLM model series beginning with GLM-5.
